name: FEA-Bench-v1.0-Oracle
description: FEA-Bench-v1.0-Oracle evaluates models on their ability to produce factually grounded answers and concise explanations conditioned on an oracle/reference. It measures factual accuracy, explanation faithfulness, and consistency with provided ground-truth evidence across short-answer and explanation-style prompts. The benchmark is intended to compare how well models adhere to an authoritative source when generating explanations.
reputation: A niche benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with modest adoption among factuality and explanation-evaluation researchers.
